name: Homeward Stone (Marshlight)
description: A murky teal war-trophy stone from the clan hoard, its lantern rune glowing like marsh-light. It pulls toward the waystone in Marshlight.
notes: Use it to teleport to the waystone in Marshlight's town square. It isn't used up.
All Homeward Stones share one charge: after any of them carries you, none works for a week.
Not in a fight, a dungeon or a party. Using one on the road abandons the trip. No time passes.
Sold by the vault keeper in Marshlight.
